item.title: The Strike on the Minab School Was Carried Out by an American Tomahawk, Not an Iranian Missile
item.description: On February 28, 2026, American destroyers launched dozens of Tomahawk missiles at targets in Iran. That same day, a missile struck a school in Minab, claiming the lives of more than 160 children.
